description: List a filesystem's webhooks: url, path_prefix, state (active or disabled), disabled_reason (failing or access_revoked) and the last delivery's outcome (last_success_at, last_failure, failing_since). Needs read-write access to the filesystem. Creating a webhook and rotating its secret are not tools, because their answer is the signing secret: run `mountable webhooks create` or `rotate-secret` (or use the SDKs) where the receiving backend stores it. org_id is optional: an API key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. Read-only and safe to retry. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.
name: list_webhooks
